headline: Approved ESEA/Title Funds Application and voted on four student disciplinary hearings, including one expulsion with services and three readmissions.
summary: The committee approved the ESEA/Title Funds Application by a 6-0 vote. It then held four separate student disciplinary hearings in executive session, voting to expel one student with services and to readmit three other students.
decisions: Approved motion to expel Student A with services, 6-0.
Approved motion to readmit Student B (I.A.), 6-0.
Approved motion to readmit Student C (K.A.), 6-0.
Approved motion to readmit Student D (M.A.), 6-0.

MINUTES OF THE LEWISTON SCHOOL COMMITTEE MEETING HELD 
WEDNESDAY, JULY 29, 2026 AT 5:30 PM AT THE DINGLEY BUILDING. (NOTE: These 
minutes are not official until approved by the School Committee. Such action, either to approve or 
amend and approve, is anticipated at the AUGUST 17, 2026 meeting). 
 
Members Present: Phoenix McLaughlin, Luke Jensen, Janet Beaudoin, Elizabeth 
Eames, Lynnea Hawkins, Scott Harriman, Jake Langlais 
 
Members Absent: Julia Harper, Meghan Hird, Emily Levasseur 
 
Employees Present:  
 
Others Present:  
 
 
CALLED TO ORDER  
Chairperson Phoenix McLaughlin called the meeting to order at 5:33 PM, and the Pledge of 
Allegiance was recited. 
 
SCHOOL COMMITTEE INTRODUCTIONS 
 
ESEA FEDERAL PROGRAMS 
Jenny Darigan shared slides. 
VOTED: (1) Motion to approve ESEA/Title Funds Application.  
Luke Jensen – Janet Beaudoin (6-0). 
 
EXECUTIVE SESSION

hearing [Title 20-A §1001(9) and Title I §405 (6) (B)]. Janet Beaudoin – Elizabeth Eames 
(6-0) 
 
Entered into executive session at 6:07 PM 
 Returned to open session at 6:24 PM

VOTED: (4) Motion to enter into executive session to conduct Student B disciplinary hearing

Entered into executive session at 6:25 PM 
 Returned to open session at  6:42 PM 
 
VOTED: (5) Motion to readmit. (I.A.) Janet Beaudoin – Luke Jensen (6-0) 
 
VOTED: (6) Motion to enter into executive session to conduct Student C disciplinary hearing 
[Title 20-A §1001(9) and Title I §405 (6) (B)]. Janet Beaudoin – Luke Jensen (6-0) 
 
Entered into executive session at 6:45 PM

VOTED: (7) Motion to readmit. (K.A.) Janet Beaudoin – Luke Jensen (6-0)
MINUTES – LEWISTON SCHOOL COMMITTEE MEETING HELD MAY 11, 2026 – PAGE 2 
 
VOTED: (8) Motion to enter into executive session to conduct Student D disciplinary hearing

ADJOURN
